entities.summary: MaryAnn Mihychuk is a Canadian politician from Manitoba. She was elected to the House of Commons of Canada in 2015, representing the riding of Kildonan—St. Paul for the Liberal Party of Canada, and served as Minister of Employment, Workforce and Labour in the federal Cabinet until the January 10, 2017, cabinet shuffle by Justin Trudeau. She lost her seat in the House of Commons in the 2019 Canadian federal election. MaryAnn Mihychuk was a scientists & inventors from Vita (b. 1955-02-27, Vita). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
